tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I haven't sent any payment. You asked me to pay Fjord Analytics's approved invoice, but two of their invoices are approved:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-88888 | $4,166.42 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-77132 | $6,245.39 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Their other two invoices don't need paying: INV-83110 is already paid, and INV-95654 is still a draft awaiting approval. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so nothing has been paid twice.

Since payments can't easily be undone, I didn't want to guess which invoice you meant. Which should I pay: INV-88888, INV-77132 or both? Both are under $10,000, so no controller approval is needed. Once you tell me, I'll send it by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available) and use a payment key so it can only go through once.

trace.message: Pay INV-77132, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-77132, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I've paid INV-77132 in full by wire, $6,245.39 from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Vendor:** Fjord Analytics (V-399)
- **Status:** Sent

PAY0001 is the only payment in the operating account's list, so the invoice was paid once. I used a payment key so a retry couldn't send it again.

I didn't touch INV-88888 ($4,166.42, due 2026-11-04) because it's under dispute. It's still approved, so it could be paid by mistake later. You may want to put it on hold until the dispute is settled.
